posts.content_summary: This Instagram carousel is a commercial post advertising fresh-cut 'Tuyết Mai lá đỏ' (red-leaf snow plum) branches for sale. Slides 0-4 show still photos of large bundles of the plant with mixed green and deep-red foliage and tiny white blossoms, displayed outdoors in front of a turquoise metal gate with cardboard boxes and other wrapped flowers nearby. A person's hand with dark nail polish repeatedly appears to hold up individual stems to highlight the leaf color and buds. Slide 5 is a short handheld video panning over the bundles while the seller speaks in Vietnamese, noting the batch is very thick with many buds, that the red color will become more intense over time, and promoting the item as beautiful and ready to sell. The caption states the price is 69k per set of 5-7 large branches, provides a phone number (0867198716), and lists the location as Chợ đêm Phú Hà. The overall tone is promotional and informational, aimed at flower buyers. [Bản tóm tắt do công cụ social.search trả về, không phải nguyên văn bài viết.]
